messages:
devon: FYI sec-bot just ran the quarterly entitlement-scan and surfaced a small set of svc accounts with project-level Owner bindings. tagging eng-sre + infra. priority: P2.
sec-bot: SCAN_RESULT: entitlement-sweep-2026-04-10
```
found: 5 principals with roles/owner on projects/redwood-prod/*
examples:
  serviceAccount:onboarder@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com -> roles/owner (created by onboarding-script v0.9)
  serviceAccount:legacy-backup@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com -> roles/owner (created 2023-06-11)
```
priya: Ack. Noted pattern: owner assigned by onboarding-script. We should stop granting owner to long-lived svc accts immediately. Who owns the onboarding repo?
mike: I do. onboarding repo: github.com/redwood-infra/onboard. The script uses a terraform module that still assigns owner for ease during bootstrap. bad pattern.
elaine: We need an emergency mitigation path before changing the module. Steps: (1) identify runtimes that actually need owner vs those that only need narrower perms, (2) create least-priv roles or predefined role list, (3) stage PR to change module defaults, (4) add blocking CI lint to prevent owner grants to svc accts.
ops-bot: SEARCH: `gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-prod --flatten=bindings[] --format="table(bindings.role, bindings.members)" | grep OWNER` returned 5 matches.
hugo: Suggestion: quick triage runbook:
- run `gcloud iam roles list --project=redwood-prod` to check custom roles
- for each svc acct with Owner, run `gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-prod --filter="bindings.members:serviceAccount:ONBOARDER" --format=json` to get context
- open a scoped PR with minimal perms and run smoke tests for 48h before revoke.
priya: For compliance, we also need an evidence bundle: auditlog showing who granted Owner, PR diffs that removed Owner, and a rollback plan. I'm making ticket SE-6024 and will add required artifacts checklist.
devon: I'll own the inventory and sampling. I'll run a one-off script to dump svcacct -> roles and annotate each with last-used timestamp (from token-usage logs). command I'll run: 
```
gcloud iam service-accounts list --project=redwood-prod --format=json > svcaccts.json
# then for each svcacct
gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail:"serviceAccount:NAME@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com"' --project=redwood-prod --limit=1 --format=json
```
mike: I'll open the infra PR to change onboard module to not include Owner by default and add a migration note. prefer to add an `allow_owner=false` flag defaulted to false. PR: https://github.com/redwood-infra/onboard/pull/214 (WIP).
elaine: Add a CI rule in terraform-lint that errors when bindings include `roles/owner` against `serviceAccount:` members. I'll file a follow-up (ENGSEC-5973).
priya: Calendar: scheduling the quarterly entitlement sweep as a recurring event "Entitlement Sweep (eng-security)" and inviting eng-sre, infra, and product-security. First occurrence: 2026-04-17 10:00 PT. I'll attach the sweep checklist to the calendar event.
hugo: Quick policy: block Owner grants to principals matching `*@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` unless the grant is human-approved via PR and annotated with owner justification. We'll implement as a policy check in deployment pipelines.
devon: Running inventory now. If any Owner binds are not migrated within 7 days we'll escalate to oncall and block autopromotions. Starting dump, ETA 45m.
sec-bot: NOTE: detected 2 svc accts with Owner that have not had token usage in >180 days -> flagged for removal candidate list.
priya: Good call. For each candidate we need owner contact, last-used, and business justification. If none, add to scheduled prune list.
mike: WIP PR created and includes migration script and tests. I will also add a migration guide for infra teams to validate their services.
elaine: Once PR merges, we should run a canary by changing a non-critical svcacct first, validate decrypt/secrets/ops flows, then scale. Document rollback steps in runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/entitlement-prune.
ops-bot: ACTION_TICKET: SE-6024 created by priya at 2026-04-10T14:03:22Z with checklist: inventory, PR, audit evidence, scheduled sweep event.
devon: Inventory complete: 5 svc accts with Owner, 3 are onboarding legacy-created, 2 are backups. Pushing candidate list to SE-6024.
priya: Assignments: devon -> inventory + sample evidence, mike -> infra PR to remove default owner, elaine -> CI lint rule + runbook update, hugo -> pipeline enforcement policy, me -> compliance artifacts + calendar.
hugo: I'll prototype the pipeline check today and post a short RFC in #eng-security for review.
devon: Summary: agreed immediate actions (change module default + migration PR), schedule quarterly sweep, add CI/pipeline checks, collect compliance evidence, then prune or re-scoped Owner bindings. Will reopen if we find anomalous token use. :white_check_mark:
